title: Unacademy Agrees to Sell to upGrad for $206M, Far Below Its Peak Valuation
dek: The Indian edtech company’s sale to rival upGrad underscores how sharply startup values can reset after a peak fundraising cycle.
socialCaption: Unacademy’s $206M sale to upGrad, roughly 94% below its peak valuation, is a blunt reminder that private-market marks are not exit prices. The next question: how the rival-led integration reshapes India’s edtech market.
